title: Deployability of published lung adenocarcinoma transcriptomic prognostic signatures: a systematic audit of computational reproducibility and external transportability
description: Code, derived data, source data and figures for a systematic computational deployability, reproducibility and external transportability audit of published lung adenocarcinoma transcriptomic prognostic signatures. This release is not a new prognostic-model discovery study and does not constitute clinical deployment validation. Exploratory AI and stability-guided core-score analyses are post hoc.
